journey.name: pubky ring choice rows
journey.description:
Verifies that the Pubky Ring choice screen lists every Ring identity straight away under its truncated key and fills each name in as its profile lookup finishes. While a row's lookup runs, a spinner takes the place of its avatar, so a row still looking up can be told apart from a row whose identity has no profile. It also verifies that tapping a row shows a spinner on that row only and disables every row until adoption finishes.
Precondition (not a listed capability): Pubky Ring (package app.pubkyring) installed on the same device with at least two identities, at least one of them with a published profile name. Bitkit reads Ring's shared pubky provider only when Ring is signed with the same key as the Bitkit build, so a dev build needs a Ring build signed with this repository's app/debug.keystore; with any other signature the choice screen offers only "Create profile with Bitkit" (testTag "PubkyChoiceCreate"). Also needed: an onboarded dev wallet with Paykit enabled (the default) and no active Pubky identity in Bitkit. The named identity is the one with a published name. Tapping its row signs in with it, so sign out of it in Bitkit before running the journey again.
A warm network can finish the lookups and the adoption before the screen is inspected; the steps report that rather than failing. To catch them on an emulator, run adb emu network delay gprs and adb emu network speed edge before the first step, and adb emu network delay none and adb emu network speed full after the last; a physical device needs another way to slow its connection.
Android differs from iOS in identifiers and in three steps. Every row carries the same testTag, and so does every lookup spinner, so tell the rows apart by their key caption; the avatar carries testTag "PubkyContactAvatar" and the adoption spinner none, as the Identifiers table in journeys/README.md records. On Android both spinners' accessibility description reads "Loading your profile…". A disabled row ignores taps, so the disabled check taps another row rather than reading the layout dump. The profile button always opens the next screen, so it needs no second tap, and the import overview has no testTag, so it is named by its "Import" title. See README.md.

actions.action: Run `adb shell am force-stop to.bitkit.dev`, then `adb shell am start -n to.bitkit.dev/to.bitkit.ui.MainActivity`, so no Ring row profile is remembered from earlier in the session
If the PIN screen appears, unlock the wallet
If the Profile intro (testTag "ProfileIntro") appears, tap Continue (testTag "ProfileIntro-button")
Verify the choice screen shows one row per Ring identity (testTag "PubkyChoiceIdentity") and no create option (testTag "PubkyChoiceCreate")

Verify every row is already tappable and captioned with its truncated key in capitals: the key's first four and last four characters around "...". A row whose name has not arrived also shows that truncated key as its title. If every name is already showing, the lookups finished first: report "already resolved" rather than failing

Verify each row whose lookup is still running shows its key icon and a spinner (testTag "PubkyChoiceIdentityLookup") in place of its avatar. If every row already shows its avatar, the lookups finished first: report "already resolved" rather than failing
Wait for the row for the named identity (testTag "PubkyChoiceIdentity", told apart by its key caption) to show its published name as its title
Verify that row keeps its truncated key as its caption, and any row whose identity has no published name still shows its truncated key as its title
Wait up to a minute for each row's lookup spinner (testTag "PubkyChoiceIdentityLookup") to be gone. The lookup for an identity with no profile can take several seconds to give up

Verify no row shows the lookup spinner (testTag "PubkyChoiceIdentityLookup") any more: every row shows its avatar (testTag "PubkyContactAvatar"), either its profile picture or the first character of its title. The avatar has no text, so check it from a screenshot
Tap the row for the named identity (testTag "PubkyChoiceIdentity", told apart by its key caption)
Straight away, capture a layout dump and a screenshot before adoption finishes

Verify every Ring row is disabled while the identity is adopted. A disabled row ignores taps, so tap a different row (testTag "PubkyChoiceIdentity") and verify nothing changes: the spinner stays on the tapped row and no second adoption starts. If adoption finished before the capture, report "already adopted" rather than failing

Verify from the screenshot that only the tapped row shows a spinner, in place of its key icon, while it keeps its avatar and every other row keeps its key icon and its name or truncated key. The key-icon spinner has no testTag, so a layout dump cannot settle this. If adoption finished before the capture, report "already adopted" rather than failing
Verify the choice screen gives way to the contact import overview (no testTag; titled "Import") or Pay Contacts (testTag "PayContactsContinue")
